description: Whether the product's usage data is set up and what Users can show yet. setup is the first of: no_loader (this server has no loader release), not_configured (no widget key), key_disabled (every widget key is off), not_seen (the key's script never loaded), counting_off (Count visits is off for that key), no_visits (the script loaded but no visit arrived) or ready. counting_off and no_visits only show while usageAvailable is true. usageAvailable false means this server isn't saving new visits; what it already saved still shows. keyId is the widget key setup is about, and latestLoadedAt is when its script last loaded: a past load, not proof that anything is collected now. meter is today's events and this month's signed-in users against the plan's limits, or null. Reads only what featury already stored, doesn't turn collection on and spends no credits. MANAGER+ required.
name: get_users_state
title: Check what Users can show
